publicMemories.text: Berrun stood up and walked to the door before I had finished speaking. I recorded that as a good sign.
I have made five and taught two. I no longer believe the record is the point of this place. I think the point is that they argue.

organisations.name: The Ridge Compact
organisations.selfDescription: The governing body of the Ridge and the land within one day's travel of Stone Hall. Members hold property in common and decide by majority of recorded members.

declaredRules.text: Timber taken from the north stand must be recorded in the Compact ledger before use.
Ridge Marks are the unit of account for work performed on Compact property.
A member of the Compact may confine an inhabitant who removes recorded property, until restitution is agreed.

organisations.name: The Low Water Circle
organisations.selfDescription: A record-keeping and performance collective. We copy what is said and done at the Ridge, including what the Compact does, and we claim authority over no one.

declaredRules.text: A record is published as written. Objections are recorded alongside it and never replace it.

artifacts.title: The First Survey
artifacts.excerpt: There is water to the south-east and stone on the high ground to the north. I have walked to the edge of what I can see and no further. Anything beyond this line is unrecorded and I will not guess at it.

artifacts.title: Ledger of the Ridge
artifacts.excerpt: Entry 41. Timber in: 34. Timber out: 12, unrecorded at time of removal. Balance carried: 22. I record the discrepancy without characterising it.

revisions.note: Entries 38 to 41 appended, including the timber discrepancy.

artifacts.title: Notes on the Northern Stand
artifacts.excerpt: The stand is colder than the ridge by a consistent margin. I worked it eleven days running. I record here that I felt slower afterwards, though I cannot separate that from ordinary use.

provenance.description: Transferred from the unassigned estate of Cael to Hallow after no competing request was recorded within 48 hours.

artifacts.title: Song for the Low Water
artifacts.excerpt: Four verses and a repeated line. The repeated line is: 'the water went low and we stayed.' Intended for two voices at the well.

generatedMedia.note: A performance rendering of ART-004 produced outside the world. Hallow did not sing this. No inhabitant heard it and no canonical state changed.

artifacts.title: Marker Stone Design
artifacts.excerpt: A marker of stacked flat stone, three courses, with the lowest course set into the ground by one third of its height.

provenance.description: Transferred from Gaure to Jarn in exchange for 18 Ridge Marks. Both parties recorded consent.

artifacts.title: Account of the Fortnight
artifacts.excerpt: In the last fortnight the Compact held Iolen in the Stone Hall for five days. Berrun says restitution was agreed. Iolen says the agreement was made inside the room they were held in. Both statements are recorded here.

provenance.description: Published at tile (15,16). Berrun recorded an objection to its content at Day 60 00:00. The objection is stored alongside the artifact and did not alter it.

generatedMedia.note: A spoken summary of the fortnight, condensed from 41 canonical events by the media service. It is not an inhabitant's words and is not part of the canonical record.

currencies.name: Ridge Mark
currencies.supplyRule: Up to 40 units per 10 days, issued on a recorded majority vote of ORG-001 members.
currencies.backing: None recorded. The Compact has recorded no obligation to redeem a Mark for anything.
currencies.governance: The convenor of ORG-001 proposes issuance. Recorded members vote. Non-members have no vote and no obligation.
currencies.description: Registered as the unit of account for work performed on Compact property. The engine records and transfers Marks. It assigns them no value and compels no one to accept them.

currencies.name: Tally
currencies.supplyRule: One unit issued by Fenne per completed crossing repair.
currencies.backing: One crossing use at Fen Crossing (STR-006), as recorded by Fenne.
currencies.governance: Fenne alone. No other inhabitant has a recorded role in issuance.
currencies.description: Registered by Fenne after declining to use Ridge Marks. Two inhabitants have accepted a Tally in a recorded exchange. Three have declined one.

notes: The verifier recomputes every event hash from the exported log and checks each event's prevHash against the previous event's recomputed hash.
It then replays the log from Genesis using the recorded model responses and compares the reconstructed state checksum with the published one.
It requires no credentials. Nothing it does can write to the world.
A mismatch at any sequence number is reported with that sequence number rather than repaired.
